critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the single horizontal window line on the fuselage with a 3x4 grid of small rectangular primitives. Set each primitive's width to 0.8 units, height to 0.25 units, and arrange them in three distinct rows. Apply a slight Z-axis offset (incrementing by 0.05 per row) and a subtle radial rotation to the grid to follow the fuselage curvature, ensuring they are spaced 0.1 units apart from each other.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct rows of windows with specific spacing and grouping
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase number of primitive objects for window units

discrepancies.observed: No distinct geometric boundaries or recessed lines for doors
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular door frames with visible seams
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add thin box geometries to define door perimeters

discrepancies.observed: Windows are placed in a perfectly straight horizontal line across the curve of the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Windows follow the slight taper and curvature of the aircraft body
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: adjust z-positioning of window primitives along the fuselage arc

discrepancies.observed: A single small dark area at the nose
discrepancies.reference: A multi-paneled, wrap-around cockpit window structure
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace single primitive with a cluster of angled planes
